name: Vercel MCP
summary: Vercel's official remote MCP server at mcp.vercel.com, an OAuth-authenticated endpoint that gives an AI assistant access to a Vercel account: the vendor lists searching Vercel documentation, managing projects and deployments, analysing logs, querying Web Analytics, inspecting Agent Runs, and Purchase tools that buy Pro, prepaid credits, the SIEM add-on and domains on a team's behalf, charged to the team's payment method. Measured 2026-09-21: initialize, tools/list and a call of the documentation tool all answer 401 with the same Bearer challenge.

payments.notes: 2026-09-22: no surface prices an agent call and no request drew a 402, so machinePayable is false. The vendor documents the reverse: Purchase tools charge the team's card on file "immediately" and "non-refundable" after a quote-then-confirm flow. Nothing was bought.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-12 and 2026-09-21, no credentials, cloud IP: MCP initialize, tools/list and a tools/call of search_vercel_documentation each answer 401 with the same Bearer challenge; resource_metadata names vercel.com as the authorization server, scope openid. No public tool was reached.

jobs.summary: Vercel MCP, the vendor's words: it lets an AI assistant "Search and navigate Vercel documentation", scoped to Vercel's own documentation, alongside its project and deployment tools. Not measured: a keyless tools/call of search_vercel_documentation answered 401 on 2026-09-21.

The vendor's words: Purchase tools "make purchases on behalf of a team". Quote with get_purchase_quote, then buy_pro, buy_credits, buy_addon or buy_domain with confirm true and the quote's key; "charges go to the team's payment method immediately and are non-refundable". Not measured.
